_status: Calibrated 2026-10-10 on 9 iPhone before/after pairs (evals/larp-shoot-1, tools/calibrate.py). Base = median of 8 pairs (02 excluded as a different style). Leave-one-out error 0.029 vs 0.070 unedited.
_description: The author's signature: mid-tones pulled down with brightness while lights stay bright, a little warmer, colour slightly richer. No grain, vignette, or colour wash.

night._when: Night/indoor lit by lamps, candles, LED strips; also most landscapes and general scenes. Same as the base.
night._from: pairs 01, 03, 06, 09 (close fits); 07 and 10 also near it

lit-subject-in-dark._when: A lit subject (person, outfit, watches) surrounded by near-black. Keeps texture in the subject.

daylight._when: Bright daytime street, cars, architecture, hard sun.

cool-muted._when: OPT-IN ONLY: the user asks for a cold, washed-out look. Not for landscapes in general (tested on 3 landscapes: wrong).
